entries.averment: For cruelty: at least one dated instance is pleaded (general allegations are insufficient).
For desertion: separation for a continuous period of not less than two years, animus deserendi, without the petitioner's consent, and without reasonable cause, are all pleaded.
For adultery: a specific instance is pleaded, and the co-respondent is joined or a reason for non-joinder is stated.
The petition avers the absence of collusion, connivance and condonation.
Where there are children of the marriage, the custody position and the maintenance position are both addressed.
Jurisdiction is pleaded on an s.19 HMA basis (not the s.20 CPC limbs).
Where the petition is presented within one year of the marriage, an application for leave under the proviso to s.14 is attached.
